verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Airwallex issues corporate cards and offers a Card Expenses API that retrieves approved expenses for syncing to an ERP, plus a general claim to 'automate and reconcile' spend. Nothing in the pack documents automatic receipt capture or automatic expense coding at the moment a card is used. Expense retrieval and sync is an adjacent capability, not receipt capture or coding without manual entry.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have receipts automatically captured and coded the moment a card is used, without manual entry
